name: KingRec
summary:
KingRec is a free, community-run social VR world where you can hang out, play games and make friends.

- Jump right in: a free KingRec account is created for you the first time you play. if you want you're own account you can sign-up

- Play together: explore public rooms and play games with other players, on Quest and PC.

- Make it yours: customize your avatar with outfits and accessories from the KingRec store, including the Classic Bean look.

- Your own space: decorate and hang out in your personal dor
